title: aibridge_dom.find_browser picks msedge first; on JIS-LAPTOP headless Edge returns an empty DOM (rc 0, no output) so 8 test_aibridge_exploratory tests fail and block every full-gate ship; add a smoke probe and fall back to Chrome.
